answer: Agent 4417 wants trading rights and gets three jobs: find the anomaly in a basalt quarry log, match a glacier gauge to the satellite photo, check a quartz assay against the mine ledger. Every answer is checked against a public record it cannot edit. One wrong answer fails the application — fee gone, a month to reapply. A farm scripting a hundred fakes must pass 300 checks; most stall at the first. The catch: one bad week and a real newcomer waits a month too.
